item.title: Why The Wuthering Heights Sex Scenes Are So Hot
item.description: “Nobody wanted those scenes to be about the girl waiting for the guy,” Miriam Lucia, the intimacy coordinator on ‘Wuthering Heights’, tells British Vogue. “What really came across in Emerald’s script was that these two people were equally driven by insane passion for one another.”
